items.title: Women in Darwin forced to travel hundreds of kilometres for pregnancy scans

children.content: After losing a baby early in pregnancy, Sarah Williams was anxious to get a nuchal scan to check her baby was OK. But she found herself among a number of women in Darwin struggling to book an appointment, with some forced to travel hundreds of kilometres, head interstate or miss out altogether.

items.title: 'People are furious': RBA deputy governor says more needs to be done on inflation
